cells.gaps: The wallet and app use rest on WISeKey's own 2024 release; no government source says how many people use them.
cells.note: WISeKey says the SeyID app gives passwordless access and its e-wallet holds the National ID as a digital card with a QR code for third-party checks (SYC-010, SYC-009); SeyID gates government e-services on a portal hosting all entities' systems (SYC-004, SYC-002). Top rung.
